insight: Nvidia agreed a ~$20B cash deal on Dec 24, 2025 to license Groq's LPU IP and acquihire its team — Nvidia's largest deal ever.
name: Groq
tagline: Ultra-fast inference on custom LPU chips. Open-weights at 500+ tokens/sec.
description: GroqCloud serves open-weights models (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi) on Groq's purpose-built LPU hardware, hitting hundreds of tokens per second where GPUs manage tens. OpenAI-compatible API with a free tier; the default when token latency is the product.

modelSupport.notes: Open-weights catalog on Groq LPUs; OpenAI-compatible API.

edge: Custom LPU silicon delivers deterministic sub-100ms TTFT, ideal for voice and latency-critical apps.
pros: Hundreds of tokens/sec on open models
